biomes.title: OPEN on purpose, and NOT the spine's biome vocabulary. The 170 rows use 19 distinct strings; scripts/lib/spine.mjs's BIOMES is a CLOSED 12 (ocean ice marsh river meadow forest bramble rock upland alkali ash built), and 8 of the 19 are outside it (badland desert karst lake lava reef scree tundra). Measured 2026-08-20: 93 of the 170 rows name at least one. Plan Task 5's mandated test "every biome named by a lexicon row is in BIOMES" therefore reds on 93 rows as written — Task 5 must first decide whether to widen BIOMES or to declare this a separate namespace. The strings themselves are dictated verbatim by the plan's Task 1 row table and are transcribed exactly, so the discrepancy is the plan's, not the data's.
